newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures higher across the board.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures higher across the board.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended higher across the board on Wednesday, supported by a weak yen and higher overseas markets, traders said.
Rubber prices ranged from 2.1 yen to 3.9 yen per kg higher. Benchmark February was up 2.1 yen at 143.4 yen.
Activity was buoyant. The market started the day on a firmer tone, as speculative buying in the spot September contract spilled over into other contracts.
The yen's weaker tone against the dollar, triggered by the weaker-than-expected tankan survey announced today, and firmer overseas markets also pushed up prices, they said.
